# Cross-compat fixture for the ntfs-3g `mkntfs` reference tool.
#
# Contract: a small NTFS image (~200 KiB, 20 MiB minimum image size required
# by mkntfs is rounded down for fixture economy via -s 512 -c 512 small-volume
# flags; see regen.sh) populated with two known files:
#
#   /hello.txt       -> contents "hello\n"
#                       size:  6
#                       md5:   b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184
#
#   /sub/blob.bin    -> 1024 bytes of deterministic random data (seed 1)
#                       size:  1024
#                       md5:   <computed by regen.sh and written here>
#
# Layout: image.ntfs.gz (gzip-compressed raw NTFS image). The test
# decompresses to a temp file, opens the image via this package's
# Open(), and asserts the two paths above exist with the expected size +
# md5. Loader: TestReadMkntfsImage in ntfs_compat_test.go.
#
# Regeneration: see regen.sh. Requires `mkntfs` (Linux ntfs-3g/ntfsprogs)
# or `mkntfs` on macOS from the `ntfs-3g` homebrew/pkgx package. When the
# tool is on PATH the test will regenerate the image in-place and verify
# the regenerated image matches as well — both committed and freshly
# generated paths are exercised.
#
# Format (parsed by ntfs_compat_test.go):
#   <path><TAB><size-in-bytes><TAB><md5-hex>
/hello.txt	6	b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184
/sub/blob.bin	1024	070f903e3b6ad4f35a82f4827587c74f
